engine: Real ESP32-S3 core assignment and capture timings; Python serial recorder/integrity checks

runs.serial_integrity: gyro count, sequence, checksum and read-gap sum verified
runs.measurement_interval: nominal 1 ms FIFO; read gaps are not sensor sample times
runs.retained_channels: raw sensor gyro only; no accelerometer or temperature in rotation mode

request_source: PC serial through slow-core request queue
physical_condition_note: Automatic transport-only check; physical motion uncontrolled; no calibration or sign acceptance
physical_button_validation: pending unless operator separately attests button actions
